units.source_text: 首先，做这种事能起什么作用呢？

en.t: First of all, what good would doing something like this do?

units.source_text: 我可不是牛马，不可能违背个人意志，强迫我劳动呀。

en.t: I am not a draft animal; you cannot force me to work against my own will.

units.source_text: 假如，起不到劳动力的作用，那么，把我囚禁起来可就没有任何意义了吧。

en.t: If I am of no use as labor, then there is no point at all in keeping me imprisoned, is there?

units.source_text: 对那女人来说，也不过多一张白吃饭的嘴，多一些自找的麻烦而已。

en.t: For that woman, it would only mean one more mouth to feed for nothing, and a little more trouble she had brought on herself.
